properties.name: mcp.api.token
properties.description: API token for MCP endpoint auth. Set via MCP_API_TOKEN env var.

properties.name: ollama.base.url
properties.description: Base URL for the Ollama service. Default: http://localhost:11434.

properties.name: ollama.embed.model
properties.description: Ollama embedding model name. Default: mxbai-embed-large (1024-dim). Overridable via Settings UI.
